newsitem.title: USA: Oregon Steel Pueblo mill at half power.
newsitem.headline: Oregon Steel Pueblo mill at half power.

text.p: Oregon Steel Mills Inc said Monday Public Service Co of Colorado has lost the use of one of the two main transformers that supply electricity to the melt shop at the CF&I Steel Division in Pueblo, Colo., curtailing available power by one-half.

A backup transformer, which had already been on order, is being expedited from the supplier with expected delivery by late November. Following installation and start-up of the new transformer, full power should be restored by early December.
Oregon Steel said CF&I projects actual steel production to be reduced to about 65 percent of its average rate.
CF&I expects rail and seamless pipe production and shipments to be unaffected during the fourth quarter.
The reduction in steelmaking will primarily impact rod, bar and wire production and shipments, the company said.
